query: I spent all weekend perfecting my sourdough starter, it finally doubled in size after I fed it that special organic rye flour I picked up from the farmers' market on Saturday. Then last night I tried making my first loaf, it came out with such a nice crispy crust and the crumb was perfectly airy, I even shared a slice with my next door neighbor who said it's the best homemade bread she's ever had. I was planning to bake another one this evening to bring to my book club meeting tomorrow, everyone's been asking to try a piece after seeing the photos I posted in our group chat. But now I'm having a bunch of issues with my phone: airplane mode is turned on, my network preference is acting up, the wifi calling isn't working right, my APN MMS settings seem to be broken, some of my apps have lost their storage permissions, data mode is turned off, I've gone over my data usage limit, and I think my SIM card might have come unseated. I need help getting all these fixed please.
